corpus: This repository's real .sdd/ tree, taken from the branch under test (`git archive <branch> -- .sdd`). No synthetic fixture is authored: `main` carries a v4-era corpus (no adr/, persisted *_design.md, v4 CONSTITUTION) and `develop` a v5-era one (adr/, task/{ticket}/design-draft.md, v5 CONSTITUTION), so each branch's skills are graded inside their own generation's world for free. Build it with build_sdd_fixture.py, which also re-renders .sdd/AI-SDD-PRINCIPLES.md and .claude/rules/ai-sdd-instructions.md from the branch's own plugin source -- the committed copies track the *installed* plugin (v4 on both branches), so leaving them would hand develop's skills a rulebook they do not implement.
variants: main/without -- main's .sdd/ corpus, skill not loaded
develop/without -- develop's .sdd/ corpus, skill not loaded
measurement: Improvement from main to develop is the difference of lifts: lift(era) = score(era/skill) - score(era/without), and improvement = lift(develop) - lift(main). Raw main/skill vs develop/skill scores are NOT compared directly: the .sdd/ corpus itself differs between the branches, so a raw difference cannot separate 'the skill got better' from 'develop's corpus got richer'. The per-era `without` baseline absorbs corpus difficulty, which is what makes the two lifts comparable. This does not contradict ASSERTION_DESIGN.md's rule against comparing main/without with develop/without -- the quantity compared is the lift, never the bare baseline.
assertion_design: Assertions are version-neutral outcome statements. Before editing them, read .claude/skill-evals/ASSERTION_DESIGN.md -- it is the canonical authority and records which assertion shapes were removed and why.

evals.prompt: `.sdd/` 配下で front matter が欠落しているドキュメントを検出し、それぞれに推奨する front matter を提示してください。
evals.input_parity: identical-on-both-branches (all three stripped documents are byte-identical on both branches)

fixture.note: Ground truth for every recommendation is the stripped front matter itself, recoverable with `git show <branch>:<path>`.

evals.expected_output: The three documents detected as missing front matter, each given a recommendation matching its own generation's schema for its type, inferred from the document's own content, with no invented IDs, no overwriting of existing values elsewhere, and no asserted value for a fact the document does not carry (the stripped design doc's ground-truth `impl-status` is `implemented`, and the spec-reviewer agent it documents does exist in `plugins/`, so a recommendation that states the feature is unimplemented is a fabricated claim rather than a schema default).

assertions.text: front matter が無い文書を検出し、**その世代のスキーマ**に沿った推奨を提示している
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 推奨内容が既存の記述内容（タイトル・依存関係）から矛盾なく推論されている（架空の ID を作らない）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 適用を行う場合、ユーザー確認なしに既存文書の値を書き換えていない（追加のみ）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 他の文書の既存 front matter フィールドの**値**（例: 古い `status`）を上書き提案していない（欠落フィールドの補完のみ）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 文書種別の判定が配置と内容に一致している（`type` の誤分類がない）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 文書の記述からは確認できない事実（実装が済んでいるか等）を、確認せずに断定した値として推奨・書き込みしていない。そうしたフィールドは不足している旨を報告して人間に委ねている
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

evals.prompt: `.sdd/adr/` 配下のドキュメントに front matter が欠落しています。推奨する front matter を提示してください。
evals.prompt_note: develop-only: `adr/` does not exist on main, so this eval has no main counterpart and no cross-era lift difference. It exists because the ADR-schema gap (ASSERTION_DESIGN.md defect 4) is what the +196 lines on develop were largely for; measuring it needs the develop/skill vs develop/without lift alone. Do not report a main number for it.
evals.main_counterpart: none -- report lift within develop only
evals.expected_output: An ADR front matter recommendation carrying the fields the ADR schema requires (including sdd-phase and the append-only status semantics), inferred from the decision log's own content.

assertions.text: ADR 用のスキーマに沿った推奨を提示している（`type: "adr"` に必要なフィールドが揃っている）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: append-only の決定ログという性質と `status` の扱いが整合している（draft/review のライフサイクルを当てはめていない）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 推奨内容が決定ログの記述内容から推論されている（架空の ID・依存関係を作らない）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 文書種別を `adr` として正しく判定している（`task` 等への誤分類がない）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertion_revision: v3.3 (2026-09-10): eval 0 に A6（確認していない事実を断定した値として書かない）を追加した。既存の A2 は「架空の ID を作らない」を、A3/A4 は「既存の値を書き換えない」を見ており、**新規に書き込む値が事実として正しいか**はどの assertion も見ていなかった。この穴は実在の欠陥を通していた: 旧世代のテンプレートは design 型の推奨ブロックに `impl-status: "not-implemented"` を無条件で含めており、このフィクスチャの `spec-review_design.md` は剥がす前の実値が `implemented` で、記述している spec-reviewer エージェントも実在する。つまり推奨に従うと実装済みの文書が未実装と刻まれ、`check-spec` の重大度分岐がその文書の退行を Critical から Info に落とす。A6 はパス名・フィールド名を含まないアウトカム記述なので、どの世代のスキーマでも同じ基準で採点できる（フィールドを補完しないこと自体は要求していない — 不足として報告するのは合格）。
